_meta.purpose: Phase 6 (s181, 2026-05-13) - curated per-item healing/shielding/ally-buff formulas for the ds.hps enchanter scorer.
_meta.source: Hand-curated from DDragon item descriptions + Meraki passive prose; Phase 6 scorer is best-effort with no in-game proc instrumentation.

schema.items.<id>.name: DDragon item name (informational; engine resolves id → name from snapshot).
schema.items.<id>.heal_per_proc_base: Healing per proc at level 1. 0 if item has no direct heal output.
schema.items.<id>.heal_per_proc_per_level: Linear growth per level (level 1..18). per_proc(level) = base + per_level × (level - 1).
schema.items.<id>.heal_per_proc_ap_scaling: AP scaling on healing per proc (0.0 = no scaling).
schema.items.<id>.heal_procs_per_second: Proc rate (1/CD for actives; 0 for passives without a per-proc model).
schema.items.<id>.heal_targets_per_proc: Avg allies hit per proc. AoE actives ~3 allies; single-target = 1.
schema.items.<id>.shield_per_proc_base: Shielding per proc at level 1. 0 if no shield output.
schema.items.<id>.shield_per_proc_per_level: Linear growth per level for shielding.
schema.items.<id>.shield_per_proc_ap_scaling: AP scaling on shielding per proc.
schema.items.<id>.heal_shield_amp_pct: Percent multiplier on total H+S throughput (unit-fraction: 0.10 = +10%). Items granting healAndShieldPower or chain multipliers (Moonstone).
schema.items.<id>.ally_buff_credit_per_second: Normalized supportive value per second for non-direct-heal items (Ardent AS aura, Mandate damage proc, Knight's Vow tank-share). Calibrated so 10 credits ~ 10 HPS in ranker score units.
schema.items.<id>.notes: Free-form explanation of the modeling decision.

modeling_notes: Phase 6 is best-effort. No ally-state plumbing (positions, current HP, ability casts). Modeled against a 'mid-game team-fight' baseline.
Active heals/shields use 1/CD as proc rate (Redemption ~120s CD, Mikael ~120s CD, Locket ~90s CD).
Targets-per-proc is operator-set: 3 allies hit on AoE actives, 1 on single-target. Caller can override via API.
ally_buff_credit_per_second is intentionally lower than direct-heal HPS (10 = roughly 10 HPS-equivalent) so direct-heal items still outscore pure buff items per gold.
Heal/shield amp percentages compound multiplicatively across items: final_amp = product(1 + amp_pct).
ARAM aramHealing/aramShielding modifiers fold into the per-proc base on the engine side; this file stores SR baseline numbers.
Chemtech Putrifier (3011) is anti-heal - intentionally excluded from this scorer's positive HPS contribution. Operators wanting it as an enchanter pick get it from rank_for fall-through.

6617.name: Moonstone Renewer
6617.notes: Starlit Grace chains 30% of heal / 35% of shield to nearby ally (or grants the same target an additional 30% heal / 35% shield if no ally in range). Modeled as a flat +30% throughput amp on the whole build's healing+shielding output (averaging the heal-chain and shield-chain modes; second-trigger fallback amortized into the same number).

3107.name: Redemption
3107.notes: Intervention active: 150→350 HP heal to allies over level 1→18 (linear, 200/17 = 11.76 per level), 120s CD, AoE so ~3 allies hit avg. Per-proc heal at lvl 11 ≈ 268. HPS at lvl 11 ≈ 268 × 3 / 120 = 6.7. Also +10% heal/shield power (additive in compound).

3222.name: Mikael's Blessing
3222.notes: Purify active: 100→250 HP heal + CC cleanse, single-target, 120s CD. Per-proc heal at lvl 11 ≈ 188. HPS at lvl 11 ≈ 1.57. +12% heal/shield power. CC cleanse modeled as 2 credits/sec ally buff (utility floor; cleansing a hard CC mid-fight is high-value but rare).

6620.name: Echoes of Helia
6620.notes: Soul Siphon: pre-mit champion damage → Soul Charges → healing pulse on heal/shield trigger. Proc rate modeled at 0.4/sec (active enchanter casting in mid-fight). Per-proc 40→70 base + 15% AP. HPS at lvl 11 (50 + 0.15×AP) × 0.4 ≈ 20-25 HPS unbuilt, 30+ with AP build.

3504.name: Ardent Censer
3504.notes: Sanctify: heal/shield ally → +25% AS + 20 on-hit magic dmg to BOTH for 6s. No direct healing. Buff credit ~15/sec for AS+on-hit ally damage value (high - Ardent is the canonical hyper-carry enabler). +10% heal/shield power.

6616.name: Staff of Flowing Water
6616.notes: Rapids: heal/shield ally → +40 AP + 15 AH to BOTH for 6s. AP-carry enabler. Buff credit ~12/sec for the AP+AH burst boost. +10% heal/shield power.

3190.name: Locket of the Iron Solari
3190.notes: Devotion active: 290→360 shield to nearby allies (5 max), decays over 2.5s, 90s CD. Per-proc shield at lvl 11 ≈ 331. Shielding HPS ≈ 331 × 3 / 90 = 11.0. No heal/shield amp on this item itself.

4005.name: Imperial Mandate
4005.notes: Coordinated Fire: ally hits CC'd target for 10% current HP magic damage. Damage proc, not healing. Buff credit ~6/sec - meaningful but lower than direct-heal items; this is the 'support mage' item that prioritizes damage output.

3109.name: Knight's Vow
3109.notes: Sacrifice: redirect 12% of bonded ally's damage taken to self; self-heal 10% of ally's damage dealt. Indirect tank-share for the bonded ally. Buff credit ~10/sec - solid ally EHP boost but only one bonded target.
